id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the chart.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

height.description: The height of the component in pixels.

defaultColors.description:
A list of default colors.
If a series doesn't have specified color it will take color from this list of foundation design tokens in order.
slate-50, blue-60, cyan-40, purple-50, plum-70, forest-40, choco-60, cyan-60, plum-30, olive-50, purple-70, forest-70

data.description: Holds the data to display in the chart.  Should be a graph and then use a transform to convert to what Sankey wants

exportable.description: Ability to download as csv, PNG or JPEG

chartActions.description:
The set of actions that don't depend on nodes or edges, e.g., export.
Listen to triggers of the Sankey actions through `CHART_ACTION_CLICK_${actionSuffix}`.

chartActionsCollapseThreshold.description: The number of actions to display on the chart header.

overlapReduction.description:
Automatic overlapping reduction will order chart nodes within each level to best avoid overlapping.
Setting this to `false` will show the nodes in the order they are returned.

currentlyClickedEdge.description:
Currently clicked edge, an array of size 2. `currentlyClickedEdge[0]` as the source node {@link UiSdlSankeyChartNodeDataSpec#id id}
and `currentlyClickedEdge[1]` as the target node {@link UiSdlSankeyChartNodeDataSpec#id id}.

title: A Sankey chart component that displays data flows
name: UiSdlSankeyChart
